map.根据净水头、流量与水轮机效率计算发电功率与年发电量: From net head, diversion flow and turbine/generator efficiencies, compute electrical output and, with annual utilisation hours, estimate annual generation for small hydropower appraisal.
map.💡 发电功率 P=ρgQHη/1000=9.81·Q·H·η (kW)；年发电量: 💡 Output P=ρgQHη/1000=9.81·Q·H·η (kW); annual energy E=P×utilization hours
map.净水头为扣除水头损失后的有效水头，非毛水头: Net head is the effective head after head losses, not the gross head
map.按水头与流量估算毛出力。: Estimate gross output from head and flow.
map.计入效率得净上网功率。: Apply efficiency for net grid output.
map.η 从 0.85 升到 0.92，同水头流量出力增约 8%，老机组改造收益明显。: η 0.85→0.92 raises output ~8% at same head/flow; old-unit retrofit pays off.
map.毛出力 ρgQH，扣机组与传动损失得净出力，再乘厂用电得上网。: Gross ρgQH; subtract unit and drive losses for net, then station use for grid output.
map.用净水头（毛水头减引水与尾水损失），非毛水头。: Use net head (gross minus intake/tailrace loss), not gross.
map.水力发电功率计算工具用于水电站出力与年发电量计算。输入净水头、流量、水轮机效率与: The hydropower output tool computes station output and annual energy. Enter net head, flow, turbine and generator efficiency to get output (kW/MW) and annual energy, plus overall efficiency and water power — core for hydropower planning and feasibility.
